question: Sales yang pernah menangani deal dari pelanggan yang punya tiket urgent terbuka, dan sales itu sendiri belum punya deal lost bulan ini.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.rep_id IN (SELECT d.rep_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.status IN ('open','in_progress'))) AND r.rep_id NOT IN (SELECT d2.rep_id FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'lost' AND d2.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today()))

question: Pelanggan yang aktivitas terakhirnya bersentimen negatif dan masih punya deal pipeline, tampilkan id dan nama.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.customer_id HAVING argMax(a.sentiment, a.timestamp) = 'negative') AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation'))

question: Pelanggan mana yang prioritas tiket terbarunya urgent tapi tidak ada aktivitas dalam 14 hari terakhir?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id HAVING argMax(t.priority, t.created_at) = 'urgent') AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 14))

question: Segmen mana yang rata-rata waktu penyelesaian tiketnya lebih lama dari rata-rata seluruh tiket?
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_rata_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment HAVING avg(t.resolution_time_hours) > (SELECT avg(t2.resolution_time_hours) FROM support_tickets AS t2 FINAL) ORDER BY rata_rata_jam DESC

question: Tampilkan sales yang kontribusi omsetnya lebih dari 3% total omset perusahaan, plus persentasenya (rasio).
sql: WITH rep_omset AS (SELECT d.rep_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.rep_id) SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(rep_omset.total_omset / (SELECT sum(rep_omset.total_omset) FROM rep_omset), 2) AS kontribusi FROM rep_omset INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON rep_omset.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE rep_omset.total_omset / (SELECT sum(rep_omset.total_omset) FROM rep_omset) > 0.03

question: Pelanggan yang punya deal won DAN deal lost di kuartal ini, siapa saja?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(today())) AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT d2.customer_id FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'lost' AND d2.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(today()))

question: Tiket dari pelanggan yang omsetnya di atas rata-rata omset per pelanggan, tapi pelanggan itu bukan Enterprise.
sql: WITH cust_omset AS (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.customer_id IN (SELECT cust_omset.customer_id FROM cust_omset WHERE cust_omset.total_omset > (SELECT avg(cust_omset.total_omset) FROM cust_omset)) AND t.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.segment != 'Enterprise')

question: Siapa saja pelanggan yang deal won pertamanya terjadi setelah tiket pertamanya dibuat?
sql: WITH first_won AS (SELECT d.customer_id, min(d.closed_date) AS won_pertama FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id), first_tiket AS (SELECT t.customer_id, min(t.created_at) AS tiket_pertama FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN first_won ON c.customer_id = first_won.customer_id INNER JOIN first_tiket ON c.customer_id = first_tiket.customer_id WHERE first_won.won_pertama > first_tiket.tiket_pertama

question: Pelanggan yang punya lebih banyak deal lost dibanding rata-rata jumlah deal lost per pelanggan (yang pernah lost).
sql: WITH cust_lost AS (SELECT d.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost' GROUP BY d.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cust_lost.jumlah_lost FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN cust_lost ON c.customer_id = cust_lost.customer_id WHERE cust_lost.jumlah_lost > (SELECT avg(cust_lost.jumlah_lost) FROM cust_lost)

question: Hitung berapa pelanggan per wilayah yang omsetnya melebihi rata-rata omset pelanggan di wilayah itu.
sql: WITH cust_omset AS (SELECT d.customer_id, c2.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c2 FINAL ON d.customer_id = c2.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id, wilayah), wil_avg AS (SELECT cust_omset.wilayah, avg(cust_omset.total_omset) AS rata_rata_wilayah FROM cust_omset GROUP BY cust_omset.wilayah) SELECT cust_omset.wilayah, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM cust_omset INNER JOIN wil_avg ON cust_omset.wilayah = wil_avg.wilayah WHERE cust_omset.total_omset > wil_avg.rata_rata_wilayah GROUP BY cust_omset.wilayah ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Tampilkan 5 pelanggan dengan pipeline terbesar beserta jumlah tiket terbuka masing-masing (0 kalau tidak ada).
sql: WITH top_pipe AS (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY d.customer_id ORDER BY total_pipeline DESC LIMIT 5), tiket_buka AS (SELECT t.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket_terbuka FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress') GROUP BY t.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, top_pipe.total_pipeline, tiket_buka.jumlah_tiket_terbuka FROM top_pipe INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON top_pipe.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN tiket_buka ON top_pipe.customer_id = tiket_buka.customer_id ORDER BY top_pipe.total_pipeline DESC

question: Pelanggan yang tidak punya deal won tapi aktivitasnya lebih banyak dari rata-rata aktivitas per pelanggan.
sql: WITH cust_aktif AS (SELECT a.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cust_aktif.jumlah_aktivitas FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN cust_aktif ON c.customer_id = cust_aktif.customer_id WHERE cust_aktif.jumlah_aktivitas > (SELECT avg(cust_aktif.jumlah_aktivitas) FROM cust_aktif) AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won')

question: Deal won yang nilainya melebihi nilai deal won rata-rata pelanggan itu sendiri, tampilkan juga nama pelanggannya.
sql: WITH cust_avg AS (SELECT d2.customer_id, avg(d2.value) AS rata_rata_won FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d2.customer_id) SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, c.name AS customer_name FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN cust_avg ON d.customer_id = cust_avg.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.value > cust_avg.rata_rata_won

question: Tim sales mana yang total pipeline-nya di atas rata-rata pipeline per tim?
sql: WITH tim_pipe AS (SELECT r.team, sum(d.value) AS total_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY r.team) SELECT tim_pipe.team, tim_pipe.total_pipeline FROM tim_pipe WHERE tim_pipe.total_pipeline > (SELECT avg(tim_pipe.total_pipeline) FROM tim_pipe)

question: Cari pelanggan yang semua tiketnya sudah resolved atau closed tapi punya lebih dari 2 tiket.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, tk.jumlah_tiket FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT t.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id HAVING countIf(t.status IN ('open','in_progress')) = 0 AND count() > 2) AS tk ON c.customer_id = tk.customer_id

question: pelanggan yg deal won-nya terakhir lebih dari 1 tahun lalu dan sekarang gak punya deal aktif
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING max(d.closed_date) < subtractYears(now(), 1)) AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT d2.customer_id FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation'))

question: Berapa persen dari semua deal won yang berasal dari pelanggan yang pernah punya tiket urgent?
sql: SELECT round(sumIf(d.value, d.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent')) / (SELECT sum(d2.value) FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'won'), 2) AS rasio_omset_urgent FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won'

question: Sales yang jumlah deal won-nya lebih banyak dari rata-rata jumlah deal won per sales, tampilkan jumlahnya.
sql: WITH rep_won AS (SELECT d.rep_id, count() AS jumlah_won FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.rep_id) SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, rep_won.jumlah_won FROM sales_reps AS r INNER JOIN rep_won ON r.rep_id = rep_won.rep_id WHERE rep_won.jumlah_won > (SELECT avg(rep_won.jumlah_won) FROM rep_won)

question: List pelanggan yang tiketnya urgent semua (minimal 1 tiket, tidak ada tiket non-urgent).
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id HAVING countIf(t.priority != 'urgent') = 0)

question: Tampilkan aktivitas ke pelanggan top 5 omset yang dilakukan oleh sales yang bukan pemegang deal pelanggan itu.
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp FROM activities AS a WHERE a.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC LIMIT 5) AND (a.customer_id, a.rep_id) NOT IN (SELECT d2.customer_id, d2.rep_id FROM deals AS d2 FINAL)

question: Rata-rata omset per pelanggan untuk pelanggan yang pernah komplain urgent vs yang tidak, bandingkan keduanya.
sql: SELECT round(avgIf(cust_omset.total_omset, cust_omset.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent')), 2) AS rata_rata_pernah_urgent, round(avgIf(cust_omset.total_omset, cust_omset.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT t2.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t2 FINAL WHERE t2.priority = 'urgent')), 2) AS rata_rata_tidak_urgent FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS cust_omset

question: Pelanggan mana yang punya deal dari lebih dari 2 sales berbeda dan juga punya tiket terbuka?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cr.jumlah_sales FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id, uniqExact(d.rep_id) AS jumlah_sales FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING uniqExact(d.rep_id) > 2) AS cr ON c.customer_id = cr.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress'))

question: Sales dengan rata-rata nilai deal tertinggi di antara sales yang punya minimal 10 deal.
sql: WITH rep_avg AS (SELECT d.rep_id, avg(d.value) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.rep_id HAVING count() >= 10) SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(rep_avg.rata_rata_nilai, 2) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM sales_reps AS r INNER JOIN rep_avg ON r.rep_id = rep_avg.rep_id WHERE rep_avg.rata_rata_nilai = (SELECT max(rep_avg.rata_rata_nilai) FROM rep_avg)

question: Tampilkan pelanggan yang punya produk Analytics-Suite di deal won, tapi tidak pernah punya deal won produk Cloud-Storage-Pro.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND has(d.products_involved, 'Analytics-Suite')) AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT d2.customer_id FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'won' AND has(d2.products_involved, 'Cloud-Storage-Pro'))

question: Pelanggan yang jumlah meeting-nya di atas rata-rata jumlah meeting per pelanggan, dan segmen-nya Mid-Market.
sql: WITH cust_meet AS (SELECT a.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_meeting FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'meeting' GROUP BY a.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cust_meet.jumlah_meeting FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN cust_meet ON c.customer_id = cust_meet.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'Mid-Market' AND cust_meet.jumlah_meeting > (SELECT avg(cust_meet.jumlah_meeting) FROM cust_meet)

question: Berapa nilai pipeline dari pelanggan yang punya omset di atas median omset pelanggan?
sql: SELECT sum(d.value) AS total_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND d.customer_id IN (SELECT d2.customer_id FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d2.customer_id HAVING sum(d2.value) > (SELECT quantile(0.5)(cust_omset.total_omset) FROM (SELECT d3.customer_id, sum(d3.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d3 FINAL WHERE d3.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d3.customer_id) AS cust_omset))

question: Per tim sales, tampilkan sales dengan omset tertinggi di tim itu.
sql: WITH rep_omset AS (SELECT r.team AS team, r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name AS rep_name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team, r.rep_id, r.name) SELECT rep_omset.team, rep_omset.rep_id, rep_omset.rep_name, rep_omset.total_omset FROM rep_omset WHERE (rep_omset.team, rep_omset.total_omset) IN (SELECT rep_omset.team, max(rep_omset.total_omset) FROM rep_omset GROUP BY rep_omset.team)

question: Pelanggan yang tiket urgent-nya lebih banyak dari rata-rata jumlah tiket urgent per pelanggan (yang pernah urgent).
sql: WITH cust_urgent AS (SELECT t.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' GROUP BY t.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cust_urgent.jumlah_urgent FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN cust_urgent ON c.customer_id = cust_urgent.customer_id WHERE cust_urgent.jumlah_urgent > (SELECT avg(cust_urgent.jumlah_urgent) FROM cust_urgent)

question: Deal pipeline yang nilainya di atas rata-rata deal pipeline di tahap (stage) yang sama.
sql: WITH stage_avg AS (SELECT d2.stage, avg(d2.value) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY d2.stage) SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN stage_avg ON d.stage = stage_avg.stage WHERE d.value > stage_avg.rata_rata_nilai

question: Siapa pelanggan yang hanya pernah berurusan dengan satu sales di seluruh deal-nya, dan punya lebih dari 1 deal?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cr.jumlah_deal FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING uniqExact(d.rep_id) = 1 AND count() > 1) AS cr ON c.customer_id = cr.customer_id

question: Sales yang pernah menangani deal pelanggan tier Gold tapi tidak punya deal won bulan ini.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.rep_id IN (SELECT d.rep_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.attributes['tier'] = 'Gold')) AND r.rep_id NOT IN (SELECT d2.rep_id FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'won' AND d2.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today()))

question: Hitung jumlah pelanggan per segmen yang total tiketnya di atas rata-rata total tiket semua pelanggan.
sql: WITH cust_tiket AS (SELECT t.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id) SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN cust_tiket ON c.customer_id = cust_tiket.customer_id WHERE cust_tiket.jumlah_tiket > (SELECT avg(cust_tiket.jumlah_tiket) FROM cust_tiket) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Pelanggan yang nilai deal terakhirnya (dibuat paling baru) lebih besar dari rata-rata nilai deal pelanggan itu.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cd.nilai_terakhir, round(cd.rata_rata_nilai, 2) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id, argMax(d.value, d.created_date) AS nilai_terakhir, avg(d.value) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS cd ON c.customer_id = cd.customer_id WHERE cd.nilai_terakhir > cd.rata_rata_nilai

question: Tampilkan deal lost dari pelanggan yang akhirnya churn dan punya tiket urgent.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost' AND d.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'churned' AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent'))

question: Rekap per wilayah sales: berapa sales yang belum punya deal won bulan ini?
sql: SELECT r.region, count() AS jumlah_sales FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.rep_id NOT IN (SELECT d.rep_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today())) GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY jumlah_sales DESC

question: Tiket mana yang waktu penyelesaiannya lebih lama dari rata-rata tiket pelanggan yang sama?
sql: WITH cust_avg AS (SELECT t2.customer_id, avg(t2.resolution_time_hours) AS rata_rata_jam FROM support_tickets AS t2 FINAL GROUP BY t2.customer_id) SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN cust_avg ON t.customer_id = cust_avg.customer_id WHERE t.resolution_time_hours > cust_avg.rata_rata_jam

question: Berapa selisih omset tahun ini dibanding rata-rata omset per tahun?
sql: WITH omset_tahun AS (SELECT toYear(d.closed_date) AS tahun, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY tahun) SELECT omset_tahun.tahun, omset_tahun.total_omset, round(omset_tahun.total_omset - (SELECT avg(omset_tahun.total_omset) FROM omset_tahun), 2) AS selisih_dari_rata_rata FROM omset_tahun WHERE omset_tahun.tahun = toYear(today())

question: Bulan-bulan mana (per bulan) yang omsetnya di atas rata-rata omset bulanan?
sql: WITH omset_bulan AS (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY bulan) SELECT omset_bulan.bulan, omset_bulan.total_omset FROM omset_bulan WHERE omset_bulan.total_omset > (SELECT avg(omset_bulan.total_omset) FROM omset_bulan) ORDER BY omset_bulan.bulan

question: Minggu mana yang jumlah tiket barunya di atas rata-rata tiket mingguan?
sql: WITH tiket_minggu AS (SELECT toStartOfWeek(t.created_at, 1) AS minggu, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY minggu) SELECT tiket_minggu.minggu, tiket_minggu.jumlah_tiket FROM tiket_minggu WHERE tiket_minggu.jumlah_tiket > (SELECT avg(tiket_minggu.jumlah_tiket) FROM tiket_minggu) ORDER BY tiket_minggu.minggu

question: Kuartal mana yang jumlah deal barunya paling tinggi, tampilkan kuartal dan jumlahnya.
sql: WITH deal_kuartal AS (SELECT toStartOfQuarter(d.created_date) AS kuartal, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY kuartal) SELECT deal_kuartal.kuartal, deal_kuartal.jumlah_deal FROM deal_kuartal WHERE deal_kuartal.jumlah_deal = (SELECT max(deal_kuartal.jumlah_deal) FROM deal_kuartal)

question: Hari apa dalam sebulan terakhir yang jumlah aktivitasnya di atas rata-rata harian bulan itu?
sql: WITH aktif_hari AS (SELECT toDate(a.timestamp) AS hari, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractMonths(now(), 1) GROUP BY hari) SELECT aktif_hari.hari, aktif_hari.jumlah_aktivitas FROM aktif_hari WHERE aktif_hari.jumlah_aktivitas > (SELECT avg(aktif_hari.jumlah_aktivitas) FROM aktif_hari) ORDER BY aktif_hari.hari

question: Tampilkan tiket yang dibuat oleh pelanggan wilayah NA.
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.attributes['region'] = 'NA')

question: sales yg pernah handle deal lost, tampilkan nama sama timnya
sql: SELECT r.name, r.team FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.rep_id IN (SELECT d.rep_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost')

question: Berapa pelanggan yang tiketnya pernah berprioritas urgent dan berstatus open?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.status = 'open')

question: Cari pelanggan yang tidak pernah punya aktivitas negatif.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.sentiment = 'negative')

question: deal qualification yg nilainya di bawah rata2 deal qualification
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'qualification' AND d.value < (SELECT avg(d2.value) FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'qualification')

question: Total omset dari pelanggan yang bertag tech?
sql: SELECT sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE has(c.tags, 'tech'))

question: Pelanggan mana yang tidak pernah ada tiket in_progress?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status = 'in_progress')

question: durasi aktivitas yang lebih pendek dari rata-rata durasi call, tampilkan aktivitasnya
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp FROM activities AS a WHERE a.duration_minutes < (SELECT avg(a2.duration_minutes) FROM activities AS a2 WHERE a2.type = 'call')

question: Deal dengan probabilitas di atas rata-rata probabilitas seluruh deal, tampilkan.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.probability > (SELECT avg(d2.probability) FROM deals AS d2 FINAL)

question: jumlah demo yg dilakukan sales tim Outbound-Enterprise
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_demo FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'demo' AND a.rep_id IN (SELECT r.rep_id FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.team = 'Outbound-Enterprise')

question: Tampilkan nama pelanggan beserta jumlah deal won-nya, hanya untuk pelanggan yang punya tiket urgent.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_won FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent') GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name

question: customer yang ada di daftar deal won maupun daftar deal lost, ada berapa?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won') AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT d2.customer_id FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'lost')

question: Pelanggan yang punya tiket tapi belum pernah didemo, tampilkan.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL) AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'demo')

question: Tampilkan sales yang rata-rata nilai deal-nya di bawah rata-rata nilai deal keseluruhan.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(rep_avg.rata_rata_nilai, 2) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM sales_reps AS r INNER JOIN (SELECT d.rep_id, avg(d.value) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.rep_id) AS rep_avg ON r.rep_id = rep_avg.rep_id WHERE rep_avg.rata_rata_nilai < (SELECT avg(d2.value) FROM deals AS d2 FINAL)

question: Berapa persen tiket urgent dari total tiket pelanggan Enterprise?
sql: SELECT round(countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') / (SELECT count() FROM support_tickets AS t2 FINAL WHERE t2.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise')), 2) AS rasio_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.customer_id IN (SELECT c2.customer_id FROM customers AS c2 FINAL WHERE c2.segment = 'Enterprise')

question: pelanggan yg jumlah aktivitas call-nya lebih dari 8, tampilkan id & nama
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'call' GROUP BY a.customer_id HAVING count() > 8)

question: Rekap jumlah deal per stage khusus untuk pelanggan yang punya 3 tiket terbuka atau lebih.
sql: SELECT d.stage, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress') GROUP BY t.customer_id HAVING count() >= 3) GROUP BY d.stage ORDER BY jumlah_deal DESC

question: Tampilkan aktivitas terakhir milik setiap sales.
sql: SELECT x.activity_id, x.customer_id, x.rep_id, x.type, x.timestamp FROM (SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.rep_id ORDER BY a.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM activities AS a) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1

question: Tiket terbaru dari tiap pelanggan Mid-Market.
sql: SELECT x.ticket_id, x.customer_id, x.priority, x.status, x.created_at FROM (SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at DESC) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.segment = 'Mid-Market')) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1

question: Deal won paling gede di masing2 segmen pelanggan, tampilkan id deal, judul, stage, dan nilai.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment ORDER BY d.value DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won') AS x WHERE x.rn = 1

question: Berapa banyak sales yang total aktivitasnya di atas rata-rata?
sql: WITH rep_aktif AS (SELECT a.rep_id, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.rep_id) SELECT count() AS jumlah_sales FROM rep_aktif WHERE rep_aktif.jumlah_aktivitas > (SELECT avg(rep_aktif.jumlah_aktivitas) FROM rep_aktif)

question: Pelanggan yang tiket urgent-nya lebih banyak daripada jumlah deal won-nya.
sql: WITH urg AS (SELECT t.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' GROUP BY t.customer_id), won AS (SELECT d.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_won FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, urg.jumlah_urgent FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN urg ON c.customer_id = urg.customer_id LEFT JOIN won ON c.customer_id = won.customer_id WHERE urg.jumlah_urgent > won.jumlah_won

question: Tampilkan sales beserta jumlah deal pipeline-nya, hanya untuk sales dengan omset di atas rata-rata omset per sales.
sql: WITH rep_omset AS (SELECT d.rep_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.rep_id), rep_pipe AS (SELECT d2.rep_id, count() AS jumlah_pipeline FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY d2.rep_id) SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, rep_pipe.jumlah_pipeline FROM sales_reps AS r INNER JOIN rep_omset ON r.rep_id = rep_omset.rep_id INNER JOIN rep_pipe ON r.rep_id = rep_pipe.rep_id WHERE rep_omset.total_omset > (SELECT avg(rep_omset.total_omset) FROM rep_omset)

question: Cari pelanggan SMB yang nilai pipeline-nya lebih besar dari rata-rata pipeline semua pelanggan.
sql: WITH cust_pipe AS (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY d.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cust_pipe.total_pipeline FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN cust_pipe ON c.customer_id = cust_pipe.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'SMB' AND cust_pipe.total_pipeline > (SELECT avg(cust_pipe.total_pipeline) FROM cust_pipe)

question: Pelanggan wilayah EMEA yang punya lebih dari 1 deal won tapi tidak punya tiket resolved.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.attributes['region'] = 'EMEA' AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING count() > 1) AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status = 'resolved')

question: Tampilkan deal dari sales yang timnya punya omset total tertinggi.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.rep_id IN (SELECT r.rep_id FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.team = (SELECT r2.team FROM deals AS d2 FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r2 ON d2.rep_id = r2.rep_id WHERE d2.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r2.team ORDER BY sum(d2.value) DESC LIMIT 1))

question: list pelanggan di wilayah dgn jumlah tiket terbanyak
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.attributes['region'] = (SELECT c2.attributes['region'] FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c2 FINAL ON t.customer_id = c2.customer_id GROUP BY c2.attributes['region'] ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT 1)

question: Siapa sales dengan jumlah aktivitas terbanyak? Tampilkan id, nama, dan jumlahnya.
sql: WITH rep_aktif AS (SELECT a.rep_id, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.rep_id) SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, rep_aktif.jumlah_aktivitas FROM sales_reps AS r INNER JOIN rep_aktif ON r.rep_id = rep_aktif.rep_id WHERE rep_aktif.jumlah_aktivitas = (SELECT max(rep_aktif.jumlah_aktivitas) FROM rep_aktif)

question: Pelanggan yang aktivitasnya hanya ditangani oleh satu sales saja, ada berapa?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.customer_id HAVING uniqExact(a.rep_id) = 1)

question: Total nilai deal won dari pelanggan yang aktivitas terakhirnya bersentimen positif.
sql: SELECT sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.customer_id IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.customer_id HAVING argMax(a.sentiment, a.timestamp) = 'positive')

question: Berapa kali lipat rata-rata nilai deal won dibanding rata-rata nilai deal lost?
sql: SELECT round(avg(d.value) / (SELECT avg(d2.value) FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'lost'), 2) AS rasio_won_vs_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won'

question: Tiket yg dibuat 30 hari terakhir oleh pelanggan yg total nilai pipeline-nya di atas 500 ribu
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= subtractDays(now(), 30) AND t.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING sum(d.value) > 500000)

question: Hitung jumlah pelanggan per tier yang pernah punya deal produk API-Gateway.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE has(d.products_involved, 'API-Gateway')) GROUP BY tier ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Pelanggan yang membeli (won) produk Security-Plus dan CRM-Connect sekaligus, tampilkan id & nama.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND has(d.products_involved, 'Security-Plus')) AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT d2.customer_id FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'won' AND has(d2.products_involved, 'CRM-Connect'))

question: Cari deal pipeline milik pelanggan yang aktivitas terakhirnya lebih dari 45 hari lalu.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND d.customer_id IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.customer_id HAVING max(a.timestamp) < subtractDays(now(), 45))

question: Sales mana yang deal won terakhirnya sudah lebih dari 30 hari lalu?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.rep_id IN (SELECT d.rep_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.rep_id HAVING max(d.closed_date) < subtractDays(now(), 30))

question: Tampilkan pelanggan yang tidak punya aktivitas di bulan ini tapi punya tiket yang dibuat bulan ini.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= toStartOfMonth(today())) AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(today()))

question: Rata-rata jumlah tiket per pelanggan, hanya hitung pelanggan yang pernah won deal.
sql: SELECT round(avg(ct.jumlah_tiket), 2) AS rata_rata_tiket FROM (SELECT t.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won') GROUP BY t.customer_id) AS ct

question: Berapa nilai deal rata-rata per pelanggan, dihitung dari total nilai deal tiap pelanggan?
sql: SELECT round(avg(cust_total.total_nilai), 2) AS rata_rata_total_per_pelanggan FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS cust_total

question: Tampilkan pelanggan yang tidak punya satu pun tiket terbuka dan tidak punya deal lost.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress')) AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost')

question: Customer baru tahun ini yang sudah punya deal won, tampilkan id dan namanya.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won')

question: pelanggan yg dibuat tahun lalu tapi belum punya deal apa pun sampai sekarang, brp jumlahnya?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.created_at >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND c.created_at < toStartOfYear(today()) AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL)

question: Tampilkan sales yang deal won-nya bulan lalu lebih banyak dari rata-rata deal won bulan lalu per sales.
sql: WITH rep_won AS (SELECT d.rep_id, count() AS jumlah_won FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY d.rep_id) SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, rep_won.jumlah_won FROM sales_reps AS r INNER JOIN rep_won ON r.rep_id = rep_won.rep_id WHERE rep_won.jumlah_won > (SELECT avg(rep_won.jumlah_won) FROM rep_won)

question: Pelanggan dengan jumlah deal lost lebih dari 2, plus tampilkan jumlah deal lost-nya.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cl.jumlah_lost FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_lost FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost' GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING count() > 2) AS cl ON c.customer_id = cl.customer_id

question: Segmen yang jumlah pelanggan churn-nya di atas rata-rata jumlah churn per segmen.
sql: WITH seg_churn AS (SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_churn FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'churned' GROUP BY c.segment) SELECT seg_churn.segment, seg_churn.jumlah_churn FROM seg_churn WHERE seg_churn.jumlah_churn > (SELECT avg(seg_churn.jumlah_churn) FROM seg_churn)

question: Tampilkan tipe aktivitas yang jumlahnya di atas rata-rata jumlah per tipe.
sql: WITH tipe_aktif AS (SELECT a.type, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type) SELECT tipe_aktif.type, tipe_aktif.jumlah_aktivitas FROM tipe_aktif WHERE tipe_aktif.jumlah_aktivitas > (SELECT avg(tipe_aktif.jumlah_aktivitas) FROM tipe_aktif)

question: Prioritas tiket mana yang jumlah tiketnya paling banyak?
sql: WITH prio AS (SELECT t.priority, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.priority) SELECT prio.priority, prio.jumlah_tiket FROM prio WHERE prio.jumlah_tiket = (SELECT max(prio.jumlah_tiket) FROM prio)

question: brp persen customer yg punya minimal 1 deal won dari seluruh customer?
sql: SELECT round(countIf(c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won')) / count(), 2) AS rasio_pelanggan_won FROM customers AS c FINAL

question: Berapa rasio pelanggan churn yang pernah membuat tiket urgent dibanding semua pelanggan churn?
sql: SELECT round(countIf(c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent')) / count(), 2) AS rasio_churn_urgent FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'churned'

question: Tampilkan aktivitas demo ke pelanggan yang akhirnya punya deal won.
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'demo' AND a.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won')

question: Berapa rata-rata durasi meeting ke pelanggan yang punya deal negotiation?
sql: SELECT round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_rata_durasi FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'meeting' AND a.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'negotiation')

question: Sales mana yang pernah melakukan aktivitas ke pelanggan yang tiket urgent-nya masih open? Tampilkan id, nama, dan jumlah aktivitasnya.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.status = 'open') GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY jumlah_aktivitas DESC

question: Cari pelanggan yang deal terbarunya (tanggal dibuat) masih di tahap qualification.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING argMax(d.stage, d.created_date) = 'qualification')

question: customer yg tiket terbarunya sudah closed tapi punya tiket lain yg masih open
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id HAVING argMax(t.status, t.created_at) = 'closed' AND countIf(t.status = 'open') > 0)

question: Nilai deal terbesar yang pernah dimiliki masing-masing pelanggan Enterprise, tampilkan id, nama, dan nilainya.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cm.nilai_terbesar FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id, max(d.value) AS nilai_terbesar FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS cm ON c.customer_id = cm.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise'

question: Pelanggan yang pernah punya deal bernilai di atas rata-rata deal won, tapi semua deal-nya berakhir lost atau masih berjalan (tidak ada won).
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.value > (SELECT avg(d3.value) FROM deals AS d3 FINAL WHERE d3.stage = 'won')) AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT d2.customer_id FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'won')

question: Hitung total deal pipeline dari sales yang tidak punya deal won tahun ini.
sql: SELECT sum(d.value) AS total_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND d.rep_id NOT IN (SELECT d2.rep_id FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'won' AND d2.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()))

question: Pelanggan manufaktur yang rata-rata nilai deal-nya di atas rata-rata nilai deal semua pelanggan manufaktur.
sql: WITH cust_avg AS (SELECT d.customer_id, avg(d.value) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.customer_id IN (SELECT c2.customer_id FROM customers AS c2 FINAL WHERE c2.attributes['industry'] = 'Manufacturing') GROUP BY d.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, round(cust_avg.rata_rata_nilai, 2) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN cust_avg ON c.customer_id = cust_avg.customer_id WHERE cust_avg.rata_rata_nilai > (SELECT avg(d3.value) FROM deals AS d3 FINAL WHERE d3.customer_id IN (SELECT c3.customer_id FROM customers AS c3 FINAL WHERE c3.attributes['industry'] = 'Manufacturing'))

question: Tampilkan 3 pelanggan dengan tiket terbanyak beserta semua tiket mereka.
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.customer_id IN (SELECT t2.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t2 FINAL GROUP BY t2.customer_id ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT 3)

question: 5 pelanggan paling lama tidak ada aktivitas: tampilkan id dan namanya.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.customer_id ORDER BY max(a.timestamp) ASC LIMIT 5)

question: Sales dengan jumlah deal lost terbanyak, tampilkan seluruh deal lost miliknya.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost' AND d.rep_id IN (SELECT d2.rep_id FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'lost' GROUP BY d2.rep_id ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT 1)

question: Berapa persen deal pipeline yang dipegang sales wilayah APAC dibanding seluruh deal pipeline?
sql: SELECT round(countIf(d.rep_id IN (SELECT r.rep_id FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.region = 'APAC')) / (SELECT count() FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')), 2) AS rasio_apac FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')

question: rekap jumlah tiket per status utk pelanggan yg segmennya sama dgn segmen pelanggan paling banyak tiket urgent
sql: SELECT t.status, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.segment = (SELECT c2.segment FROM support_tickets AS t2 FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c2 FINAL ON t2.customer_id = c2.customer_id WHERE t2.priority = 'urgent' GROUP BY c2.segment ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT 1)) GROUP BY t.status ORDER BY jumlah_tiket DESC

question: Pelanggan yang punya deal pipeline tapi tidak ada satu pun aktivitas meeting atau demo.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type IN ('meeting','demo'))

question: Tampilkan deal yang nilainya lebih tinggi dari deal rata-rata pelanggan Enterprise.

question: Cari tiket yang waktu penyelesaiannya di atas persentil 90 semua tiket.

question: deal yg nilainya di atas median nilai deal won
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.value > (SELECT quantile(0.5)(d2.value) FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'won')

question: Aktivitas yang durasinya di atas persentil 95 durasi seluruh aktivitas.
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp FROM activities AS a WHERE a.duration_minutes > (SELECT quantile(0.95)(a2.duration_minutes) FROM activities AS a2)

question: Berapa pelanggan yang aktivitasnya di bulan ini lebih banyak dari rata-rata aktivitas bulan ini per pelanggan?
sql: WITH cust_bulan AS (SELECT a.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY a.customer_id) SELECT count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM cust_bulan WHERE cust_bulan.jumlah_aktivitas > (SELECT avg(cust_bulan.jumlah_aktivitas) FROM cust_bulan)

question: Tampilkan tiket yang resolusinya lebih lama dari rata-rata tiket pelanggan di segmen yang sama.
sql: WITH seg_avg AS (SELECT c.segment, avg(t2.resolution_time_hours) AS rata_rata_jam FROM support_tickets AS t2 FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t2.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment) SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c3 FINAL ON t.customer_id = c3.customer_id INNER JOIN seg_avg ON c3.segment = seg_avg.segment WHERE t.resolution_time_hours > seg_avg.rata_rata_jam

question: Pelanggan yang paling baru terdaftar di tiap segmen, tampilkan id, nama, segmen, dan tanggal daftarnya.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.segment, c.created_at FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE (c.segment, c.created_at) IN (SELECT c2.segment, max(c2.created_at) FROM customers AS c2 FINAL GROUP BY c2.segment)

question: Deal terakhir yang closed (won atau lost) untuk tiap sales.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND (d.rep_id, d.closed_date) IN (SELECT d2.rep_id, max(d2.closed_date) FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage IN ('won','lost') GROUP BY d2.rep_id)

question: Tiket pertama yang pernah dibuat tiap pelanggan Enterprise, tampilkan semua tiketnya.
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise') AND (t.customer_id, t.created_at) IN (SELECT t2.customer_id, min(t2.created_at) FROM support_tickets AS t2 FINAL GROUP BY t2.customer_id)

question: Hitung pelanggan yang pernah mendapat tiket urgent tapi total omsetnya di bawah rata-rata omset per pelanggan.
sql: WITH cust_omset AS (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) SELECT count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM cust_omset WHERE cust_omset.total_omset < (SELECT avg(cust_omset.total_omset) FROM cust_omset) AND cust_omset.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent')

question: Sales yang punya deal dengan pelanggan churn dan juga dengan pelanggan active, tampilkan id dan nama.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.rep_id IN (SELECT d.rep_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'churned')) AND r.rep_id IN (SELECT d2.rep_id FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.customer_id IN (SELECT c2.customer_id FROM customers AS c2 FINAL WHERE c2.status = 'active'))

question: Total waktu penyelesaian tiket (jam) dari pelanggan yang punya deal won lebih dari 2.
sql: SELECT sum(t.resolution_time_hours) AS total_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING count() > 2)

question: Per tim sales, hitung jumlah sales yang omsetnya di atas rata-rata seluruh sales.
sql: WITH rep_omset AS (SELECT d.rep_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.rep_id) SELECT r.team, count() AS jumlah_sales FROM rep_omset INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON rep_omset.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE rep_omset.total_omset > (SELECT avg(rep_omset.total_omset) FROM rep_omset) GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY jumlah_sales DESC

question: customer yg punya tiket resolved dgn waktu penyelesaian lebih dari 100 jam tapi masih berstatus active
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'active' AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status = 'resolved' AND t.resolution_time_hours > 100)

question: Sales yang jumlah pelanggan uniknya di atas rata-rata jumlah pelanggan unik per sales.
sql: WITH rep_cust AS (SELECT d.rep_id, uniqExact(d.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.rep_id) SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, rep_cust.jumlah_pelanggan FROM sales_reps AS r INNER JOIN rep_cust ON r.rep_id = rep_cust.rep_id WHERE rep_cust.jumlah_pelanggan > (SELECT avg(rep_cust.jumlah_pelanggan) FROM rep_cust)

question: Tampilkan deal won dari pelanggan yang tidak pernah punya tiket high maupun urgent.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority IN ('high','urgent'))

question: Berapa banyak pelanggan yang punya deal tapi total nilainya di bawah 100 ribu?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING sum(d.value) < 100000)

question: Total omset tiap wilayah sales hanya dari sales yang omsetnya di atas rata-rata.
sql: WITH rep_omset AS (SELECT d.rep_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.rep_id) SELECT r.region, sum(rep_omset.total_omset) AS total_omset FROM rep_omset INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON rep_omset.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE rep_omset.total_omset > (SELECT avg(rep_omset.total_omset) FROM rep_omset) GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: Pelanggan yang omsetnya di atas rata-rata omset per pelanggan sekaligus rata-rata waktu penyelesaian tiketnya di bawah rata-rata semua tiket.
sql: WITH cust_omset AS (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id), cust_tiket AS (SELECT t.customer_id, avg(t.resolution_time_hours) AS rata_rata_jam FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cust_omset.total_omset, round(cust_tiket.rata_rata_jam, 2) AS rata_rata_jam FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN cust_omset ON c.customer_id = cust_omset.customer_id INNER JOIN cust_tiket ON c.customer_id = cust_tiket.customer_id WHERE cust_omset.total_omset > (SELECT avg(cust_omset.total_omset) FROM cust_omset) AND cust_tiket.rata_rata_jam < (SELECT avg(t2.resolution_time_hours) FROM support_tickets AS t2 FINAL)

question: Untuk tiap sales, tampilkan pelanggan dengan omset terbesar yang dia tangani (id sales, id pelanggan, omset).
sql: SELECT x.rep_id, x.customer_id, x.total_omset FROM (SELECT d.rep_id, d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.rep_id, d.customer_id) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1

question: Dari 20 pelanggan omset terbesar, ada berapa yang berstatus churned atau punya tiket urgent terbuka?
sql: SELECT count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC LIMIT 20) AND (c.status = 'churned' OR c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.status IN ('open','in_progress')))

question: Berapa persen omset tiap sales yang berasal dari pelanggan Enterprise? Tampilkan id, nama, dan rasionya.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(sumIf(d.value, d.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise')) / sum(d.value), 2) AS rasio_enterprise FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY rasio_enterprise DESC

question: Per segmen, bandingkan rata-rata omset per pelanggan dengan rata-rata omset per pelanggan seluruh perusahaan.
sql: WITH cust_omset AS (SELECT d.customer_id, c2.segment AS segmen, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c2 FINAL ON d.customer_id = c2.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id, segmen) SELECT cust_omset.segmen, round(avg(cust_omset.total_omset), 2) AS rata_rata_segmen, round((SELECT avg(cust_omset.total_omset) FROM cust_omset), 2) AS rata_rata_semua FROM cust_omset GROUP BY cust_omset.segmen ORDER BY rata_rata_segmen DESC

question: Sales mana yang win rate-nya di atas rata-rata win rate sales di tim yang sama?
sql: WITH rep_wr AS (SELECT d.rep_id, countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) AS win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.rep_id HAVING countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) > 0), tim_wr AS (SELECT r2.team, avg(rep_wr.win_rate) AS win_rate_tim FROM rep_wr INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r2 ON rep_wr.rep_id = r2.rep_id GROUP BY r2.team) SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(rep_wr.win_rate, 2) AS win_rate_sales FROM rep_wr INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON rep_wr.rep_id = r.rep_id INNER JOIN tim_wr ON r.team = tim_wr.team WHERE rep_wr.win_rate > tim_wr.win_rate_tim

question: Pelanggan active yang jumlah tiketnya lebih banyak dari jumlah dealnya, tampilkan id, nama, jumlah tiket, dan jumlah deal.
sql: WITH cust_tiket AS (SELECT t.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id), cust_deal AS (SELECT d.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cust_tiket.jumlah_tiket, cust_deal.jumlah_deal FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN cust_tiket ON c.customer_id = cust_tiket.customer_id INNER JOIN cust_deal ON c.customer_id = cust_deal.customer_id WHERE c.status = 'active' AND cust_tiket.jumlah_tiket > cust_deal.jumlah_deal

question: Pelanggan tier Gold yang omsetnya di bawah rata-rata omset pelanggan Gold lainnya.
sql: WITH gold_omset AS (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.customer_id IN (SELECT c2.customer_id FROM customers AS c2 FINAL WHERE c2.attributes['tier'] = 'Gold') GROUP BY d.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, gold_omset.total_omset FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN gold_omset ON c.customer_id = gold_omset.customer_id WHERE gold_omset.total_omset < (SELECT avg(gold_omset.total_omset) FROM gold_omset)

question: Per segmen, berapa persen tiket yang berprioritas urgent dibanding semua tiket di segmen itu? Tampilkan segmen dan rasionya.
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(countIf(t.priority = 'urgent') / count(), 2) AS rasio_urgent FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY rasio_urgent DESC

question: Pelanggan yang deal won terakhirnya (closed_date terbaru) bernilai lebih besar dari rata-rata deal won pelanggan itu.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cw.nilai_won_terakhir FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id, argMax(d.value, d.closed_date) AS nilai_won_terakhir, avg(d.value) AS rata_rata_won FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS cw ON c.customer_id = cw.customer_id WHERE cw.nilai_won_terakhir > cw.rata_rata_won

question: Sales dengan jumlah aktivitas di atas rata-rata tapi jumlah deal won di bawah rata-rata.
sql: WITH rep_aktif AS (SELECT a.rep_id, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.rep_id), rep_won AS (SELECT d.rep_id, count() AS jumlah_won FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.rep_id) SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, rep_aktif.jumlah_aktivitas, rep_won.jumlah_won FROM sales_reps AS r INNER JOIN rep_aktif ON r.rep_id = rep_aktif.rep_id INNER JOIN rep_won ON r.rep_id = rep_won.rep_id WHERE rep_aktif.jumlah_aktivitas > (SELECT avg(rep_aktif.jumlah_aktivitas) FROM rep_aktif) AND rep_won.jumlah_won < (SELECT avg(rep_won.jumlah_won) FROM rep_won)

question: Pelanggan yang dulu punya minimal 3 tiket tapi 90 hari terakhir tidak membuat tiket baru.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id HAVING count() >= 3) AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT t2.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t2 FINAL WHERE t2.created_at >= subtractDays(now(), 90))

question: Deal yang dibuat 90 hari terakhir oleh pelanggan yang sebelumnya pernah punya deal lost.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.created_date >= subtractDays(now(), 90) AND d.customer_id IN (SELECT d2.customer_id FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'lost' AND d2.closed_date < subtractDays(now(), 90))

question: Pelanggan berisiko: status active, punya tiket urgent terbuka, aktivitas terakhirnya negatif, dan pipeline di atas rata-rata pipeline per pelanggan.
sql: WITH cust_pipe AS (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY d.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cust_pipe.total_pipeline FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN cust_pipe ON c.customer_id = cust_pipe.customer_id WHERE c.status = 'active' AND cust_pipe.total_pipeline > (SELECT avg(cust_pipe.total_pipeline) FROM cust_pipe) AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.status IN ('open','in_progress')) AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.customer_id HAVING argMax(a.sentiment, a.timestamp) = 'negative')

question: Pelanggan dengan omset terbesar di setiap wilayah pelanggan, tampilkan wilayah, id, nama, dan omsetnya.
sql: WITH cust_omset AS (SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY wilayah, c.customer_id, c.name) SELECT cust_omset.wilayah, cust_omset.customer_id, cust_omset.customer_name, cust_omset.total_omset FROM cust_omset WHERE (cust_omset.wilayah, cust_omset.total_omset) IN (SELECT cust_omset.wilayah, max(cust_omset.total_omset) FROM cust_omset GROUP BY cust_omset.wilayah)

question: Tiket dari 10 pelanggan omset terbesar yang waktu penyelesaiannya di atas rata-rata tiket berprioritas sama.
sql: WITH prio_avg AS (SELECT t2.priority, avg(t2.resolution_time_hours) AS rata_rata_jam FROM support_tickets AS t2 FINAL GROUP BY t2.priority) SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN prio_avg ON t.priority = prio_avg.priority WHERE t.resolution_time_hours > prio_avg.rata_rata_jam AND t.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC LIMIT 10)

question: Sales yang tidak termasuk 10 sales dengan omset terbesar tapi jumlah pelanggannya di atas rata-rata.
sql: WITH rep_cust AS (SELECT d.rep_id, uniqExact(d.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.rep_id) SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, rep_cust.jumlah_pelanggan FROM sales_reps AS r INNER JOIN rep_cust ON r.rep_id = rep_cust.rep_id WHERE rep_cust.jumlah_pelanggan > (SELECT avg(rep_cust.jumlah_pelanggan) FROM rep_cust) AND r.rep_id NOT IN (SELECT d2.rep_id FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d2.rep_id ORDER BY sum(d2.value) DESC LIMIT 10)

question: Pelanggan yang nilai pipeline-nya lebih dari 2 kali omset won-nya.
sql: WITH cust_nilai AS (SELECT d.customer_id, sumIf(d.value, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS total_pipeline, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won') AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL GROUP BY d.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cust_nilai.total_pipeline, cust_nilai.total_omset FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN cust_nilai ON c.customer_id = cust_nilai.customer_id WHERE cust_nilai.total_omset > 0 AND cust_nilai.total_pipeline > 2 * cust_nilai.total_omset

question: Per segmen, berapa pelanggan yang pernah kalah deal (lost) tapi tidak pernah won?
sql: SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost') AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT d2.customer_id FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'won') GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Rata-rata jumlah tiket per pelanggan untuk pelanggan dengan omset di kuartil teratas.
sql: SELECT round(avg(ct.jumlah_tiket), 2) AS rata_rata_tiket FROM (SELECT t.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING sum(d.value) >= (SELECT quantile(0.75)(co.total_omset) FROM (SELECT d2.customer_id, sum(d2.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d2.customer_id) AS co)) GROUP BY t.customer_id) AS ct

question: Tampilkan sales beserta jumlah pelanggan yang punya tiket urgent terbuka dan ditangani sales itu lewat deal.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM sales_reps AS r INNER JOIN (SELECT d.rep_id, d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.status IN ('open','in_progress')) GROUP BY d.rep_id, d.customer_id) AS rc ON r.rep_id = rc.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Hari dalam seminggu apa (toDayOfWeek) yang jumlah tiket barunya di atas rata-rata per hari dalam seminggu?
sql: WITH tiket_hari AS (SELECT toDayOfWeek(t.created_at) AS hari_ke, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY hari_ke) SELECT tiket_hari.hari_ke, tiket_hari.jumlah_tiket FROM tiket_hari WHERE tiket_hari.jumlah_tiket > (SELECT avg(tiket_hari.jumlah_tiket) FROM tiket_hari) ORDER BY tiket_hari.hari_ke

question: Per bulan tahun ini, bandingkan omset dengan rata-rata omset bulanan tahun ini (selisih).
sql: WITH omset_bulan AS (SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan) SELECT omset_bulan.bulan, omset_bulan.total_omset, round(omset_bulan.total_omset - (SELECT avg(omset_bulan.total_omset) FROM omset_bulan), 2) AS selisih_dari_rata_rata FROM omset_bulan ORDER BY omset_bulan.bulan

question: Tampilkan pelanggan yang pernah membeli (won) tiga produk berbeda atau lebih.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cp.jumlah_produk FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id, uniqExact(produk) AS jumlah_produk FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS produk WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id HAVING uniqExact(produk) >= 3) AS cp ON c.customer_id = cp.customer_id

question: Produk mana yang omset won-nya di atas rata-rata omset per produk, tahun lalu?
sql: WITH prod_omset AS (SELECT produk, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS produk WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY produk) SELECT prod_omset.produk, prod_omset.total_omset FROM prod_omset WHERE prod_omset.total_omset > (SELECT avg(prod_omset.total_omset) FROM prod_omset) ORDER BY prod_omset.total_omset DESC

question: Pelanggan yang tidak pernah membeli produk Analytics-Suite padahal omset total mereka di atas rata-rata omset per pelanggan.
sql: WITH cust_omset AS (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cust_omset.total_omset FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN cust_omset ON c.customer_id = cust_omset.customer_id WHERE cust_omset.total_omset > (SELECT avg(cust_omset.total_omset) FROM cust_omset) AND c.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT d2.customer_id FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'won' AND has(d2.products_involved, 'Analytics-Suite'))

question: Sales wilayah EMEA yang jumlah deal pipeline-nya di atas rata-rata jumlah deal pipeline per sales EMEA.
sql: WITH rep_pipe AS (SELECT d.rep_id, count() AS jumlah_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND d.rep_id IN (SELECT r2.rep_id FROM sales_reps AS r2 WHERE r2.region = 'EMEA') GROUP BY d.rep_id) SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, rep_pipe.jumlah_pipeline FROM sales_reps AS r INNER JOIN rep_pipe ON r.rep_id = rep_pipe.rep_id WHERE rep_pipe.jumlah_pipeline > (SELECT avg(rep_pipe.jumlah_pipeline) FROM rep_pipe)

question: Customer yg tiketnya terbuka tapi sales yg pegang deal-nya gak pernah aktivitas ke dia, siapa aja?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress')) AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE (d.customer_id, d.rep_id) NOT IN (SELECT a.customer_id, a.rep_id FROM activities AS a))

question: Berapa persen total tiket terbuka yang dimiliki oleh pelanggan yang tidak punya deal pipeline?
sql: SELECT round(countIf(t.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation'))) / (SELECT count() FROM support_tickets AS t2 FINAL WHERE t2.status IN ('open','in_progress')), 2) AS rasio_tiket_tanpa_pipeline FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress')

question: Tiap wilayah pelanggan: jumlah pelanggan yang nilai pipeline-nya di atas rata-rata pipeline seluruh pelanggan.
sql: WITH cust_pipe AS (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY d.customer_id) SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN cust_pipe ON c.customer_id = cust_pipe.customer_id WHERE cust_pipe.total_pipeline > (SELECT avg(cust_pipe.total_pipeline) FROM cust_pipe) GROUP BY wilayah ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Deal yang nilainya lebih besar dari deal terbesar milik pelanggan SMB yang churn.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.value > (SELECT max(d2.value) FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'churned' AND c.segment = 'SMB'))

question: Pelanggan yang punya tiket pada bulan yang sama dengan deal won-nya (bulan dan tahun sama).
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT t.customer_id, toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL) AS tk ON d.customer_id = tk.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) = tk.bulan_tiket)

question: Siapa saja sales yang tidak pernah menangani pelanggan dari 20 pelanggan dengan tiket terbanyak?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name FROM sales_reps AS r WHERE r.rep_id NOT IN (SELECT d.rep_id FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL GROUP BY t.customer_id ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT 20))

question: Rata-rata nilai deal won per wilayah sales yang lebih tinggi dari rata-rata nilai deal won semua wilayah.
sql: SELECT r.region, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_rata_nilai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.region HAVING avg(d.value) > (SELECT avg(d2.value) FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'won') ORDER BY rata_rata_nilai DESC

question: Pelanggan yang aktivitas negatifnya lebih dari 30% dan omsetnya di atas rata-rata omset per pelanggan.
sql: WITH cust_omset AS (SELECT d.customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, cust_omset.total_omset FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN cust_omset ON c.customer_id = cust_omset.customer_id WHERE cust_omset.total_omset > (SELECT avg(cust_omset.total_omset) FROM cust_omset) AND c.customer_id IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.customer_id HAVING countIf(a.sentiment = 'negative') / count() > 0.3)

question: Cari tiket high atau urgent yang dibuat pelanggan sebelum deal won pertama mereka, dan pelanggan itu churn.
sql: WITH first_won AS (SELECT d.customer_id, min(d.closed_date) AS won_pertama FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY d.customer_id) SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN first_won ON t.customer_id = first_won.customer_id WHERE t.priority IN ('high','urgent') AND t.created_at < first_won.won_pertama AND t.customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'churned')

question: Pelanggan Mid-Market yang tiketnya paling banyak di antara pelanggan Mid-Market, tampilkan id, nama, dan jumlah tiketnya.
sql: WITH mm_tiket AS (SELECT t.customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.customer_id IN (SELECT c2.customer_id FROM customers AS c2 FINAL WHERE c2.segment = 'Mid-Market') GROUP BY t.customer_id) SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, mm_tiket.jumlah_tiket FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN mm_tiket ON c.customer_id = mm_tiket.customer_id WHERE mm_tiket.jumlah_tiket = (SELECT max(mm_tiket.jumlah_tiket) FROM mm_tiket)
